She holds a large rectangular mirror shard, tilting it to reflect her face and the hallway behind her. (2) With a swift downward motion of the mirror shard, the visual transitions to a woman with long black hair and glasses wearing a bright yellow crop top and black skirt. She is positioned in the same hallway environment, smiling as she holds the reflective surface. (3) Another upward wipe of the mirror reveals a woman in a white long-sleeved ribbed shirt with buttons, paired with blue jeans. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textured wall panels and a television screen in the background room. (4) A quick downward flip of the mirror shows a woman in a black strapless tube top and a necklace, looking directly into the lens. The camera maintains a medium close-up shot size throughout these rapid changes. (5) The next wipe reveals a woman with short black hair in a bob cut, wearing a black mesh top over a cutout bodice. She smiles confidently as she lowers the mirror. (6) In the final phase, the mirror reveals a woman with brownish hair and glasses, wearing a cozy white sweater and black skirt. She smiles broadly and leans slightly forward, with the background showing a dining table and kitchen area.
